Olumide Afolabi  
Email: olumide.afolabi@nexacloudbits.com | Phone: +31 6 1234 5678 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/olumideafolabi | Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands  

At NexaCloud Solutions, I specialize in designing scalable cloud architectures that balance performance with cost efficiency. Over the past two years, I’ve led the transition of our platform to a multi-cloud strategy, reducing infrastructure latency by 30% through strategic AWS and GCP integration. My focus on automation and observability has ensured 99.95% system uptime for critical services, with incident response times cut by 40% through proactive monitoring. Previously, at Aurora Systems, I optimized Kubernetes clusters for GCP, achieving a 25% reduction in compute costs while scaling to support 500k+ users. Early in my career, as a DevOps intern at CloudForge Inc., I automated CI/CD pipelines for microservices, resulting in a 50% decrease in deployment time and a 15% improvement in infrastructure efficiency.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
AWS: Spearheaded the migration of core services to AWS, implementing auto-scaling groups and EC2 Spot instances to reduce costs by 22%. Designed serverless API gateways using AWS Lambda and API Gateway, achieving 99.99% availability for high-traffic endpoints.  
Cloud cost optimization: Engineered a cost governance framework that slashed monthly cloud spend by €120k through right-sizing EC2 instances and leveraging Spot Fleet reservations.  
Infrastructure as Code: Architectured Terraform modules for multi-cloud environments, standardizing deployments across AWS and GCP and reducing environment setup time by 60%.  
CI/CD pipelines: Developed Jenkins pipelines for microservices, integrating automated testing and rollback mechanisms that cut deployment failures by 75%.  
Docker: Containerized legacy applications, reducing startup times by 40% and enabling seamless integration with Kubernetes.  
GCP: Deployed managed Kubernetes clusters on GCP, achieving 95% resource utilization through autoscaling and cost-aware scheduling.  
Load balancing: Configured HAProxy and AWS ALB to distribute traffic across global regions, improving request latency by 25% for EU users.  
Monitoring & alerting: Implemented Prometheus and Grafana dashboards for real-time metrics, reducing mean time to detect (MTTD) critical issues by 50%.  
Serverless: Built serverless architectures for data processing pipelines, achieving 99.9% reliability with zero cold start latency.  
Terraform: Automated infrastructure provisioning for 12+ environments, eliminating manual configuration errors and accelerating onboarding for new teams.  
Configuration management (Ansible): Used Ansible to automate configuration across 50+ servers, streamlining maintenance and reducing downtime.  
Database optimization: Optimized PostgreSQL queries for analytics workloads, improving query performance by 35% through index tuning and query rewriting.  
Network automation: Scripted network configurations using Python, reducing manual intervention in firewall rule updates by 70%.  
Python: Utilized Python for custom scripts in CI/CD pipelines and data analysis, automating repetitive tasks and improving deployment efficiency.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Spanish (intermediate), French (basic)

Contributed to an open-source Kubernetes operator for stateful applications, enhancing fault tolerance and reducing recovery times by 30%. Developed a cost analytics tool for cloud platforms, integrating AWS and GCP APIs to provide real-time cost insights.
